crossRefs.note: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
“You shall have no other gods before me.
They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried…
with whom Yahweh had made a covenant, and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to…
Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are…
You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not…
neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the…
Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our…
Yahweh says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my…
I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me…
So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, to…
and they came into the land of Egypt; for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice: and they came to Tahpanhes.
She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”
Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

translations.web: I said to you, “I am Yahweh your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’ ”
translations.bsb: And I said to you: ‘I am the LORD your God. You must not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not obey Me.”
translations.kjv: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
translations.asv: and I said unto you, I am Jehovah your God; ye shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell. But ye have not hearkened unto my voice.
